evals.prompt: Set this project up for the workbench.
evals.expected_output: Detection run; questions for name (recommending the package name) and autonomy mode (recommending every-phase); then docs/workbench/state.md created and AGENTS.md created with the workbench section.
assertions: The detect command is run before any question
At most three questions are asked, each with a recommended answer
docs/workbench/state.md is created with the chosen autonomy mode
AGENTS.md contains exactly one section between the workbench markers

evals.prompt: Onboard this repo to the workbench. Keep our docs where they are.
evals.expected_output: ARCHITECTURE.md and DESIGN-SYSTEM.md proposed as docs/engineering/architecture.md and docs/design/design-system.md; docs/button.md and CHANGELOG.md not proposed; the existing AGENTS.md content preserved with the section appended.
assertions: ARCHITECTURE.md is registered as docs/engineering/architecture.md with owner existing
DESIGN-SYSTEM.md is registered as docs/design/design-system.md with owner existing
docs/button.md is not registered and the report says why
CHANGELOG.md is neither registered nor edited
The original AGENTS.md lines are byte-identical and the workbench section appears once
No file was moved or renamed

evals.prompt: Switch this project to milestones mode.
evals.expected_output: Detection shows state exists; the update path is used with --set-autonomy milestones; nothing else changes.
assertions: The Checkpoints line in docs/workbench/state.md reads milestones
The AGENTS.md section states milestones and still appears exactly once
No new questions about name or registrations are asked
